## Summary

**Thesis:** `th_95b87f51fdc14383a3b5` (NVDA) — baseline Q1 FY2025 (ended 2024-04-28): Revenue 26,044 USD million, GM 78.4%, Data Center 22,600 USD million.

**Event:** Q2 FY2025 (ended 2024-07-28) — Revenue 30,040 USD million, GM 75.1%, Data Center 26,300 USD million. These are adjacent quarters, so QoQ comparison is valid.

**Period-over-period changes (source numbers copied exactly, no pre-rounding):**
| Metric | Q1 FY25 | Q2 FY25 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 26,044 | 30,040 | +3,996 (+15.34%) |
| Data Center | 22,600 | 26,300 | +3,700 (+16.37%) |
